This topic is part of the Edexcel A-Level Design Technology specification.

Designing For Cleaner Environment appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Designing For Cleaner Environment in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Edexcel board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Designing For Cleaner Environment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
